THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S. 438 OF CR.P.C PRAYING TO ENLARGE THEM ON ANTICIPATORY BAIL IN THE EVENT OF THEIR ARREST WHO ARE THE ACCUSED NO.3 TO 5 IN CR.NO.88/2024 ON THE FILE OF RESPONDENT NAZARBAD POLICE, NOW PENDING ON 4TH ADDL. CIVIL JUDGE (SR.DN.)

sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY  ORAL ORDER Accused No.3 to 5 in Crime No.88/2024 registered by Nazarbad Police Station, Mysuru, for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 408, 420, 463, 464, 468, 470 & 471 of IPC, are before this Court under Section 438 of Cr.PC.
NC: 2024:KHC:32739 2.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

3. FIR in Crime No.88/2024 was registered by Nazarbad Police Station, Mysuru, for the aforesaid offences against Pradeep Kumar and five others on the basis of the first information dated 24.06.2024 received from Hemanth C.Gowda.
Petitioners are arrayed as accused Nos.3 to 5 in the FIR.
Apprehending their arrest, they had filed Crl.Misc.No.1162/2024 which was rejected on 12.07.2024.
Therefore, they are before this Court.
4. Learned Counsel for the petitioners having reiterated the grounds urged in the petition, prays to allow the petition.

Mahadevu vs State Of Karnataka on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57694377/
2
5. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the bail application and prays to dismiss the petition.

6. From the perusal of the first information dated 24.06.2024, it is found that first informant who is an advocate and social worker had submitted a first information dated 24.06.2024 before respondent-Station House Officer of Nazarbad Police Station alleging that accused are indulged in creating documents in respect of public property and selling the NC: 2024:KHC:32739 same.
The allegation relates to creating certain documents relating to the year 2006-07 onwards.

The alleged offences are triable by the jurisdictional Magistrate and the maximum punishment for the said offences is imprisonment for a period of seven years. It is not in dispute that petitioners do not have criminal antecedents.
They have undertaken before this court to co-operate with the police for the purpose of investigation.
Considering the nature of allegations made in the FIR, I am of the view that petitioners who have no criminal antecedents have made out a case for grant of anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER The Criminal Petition is allowed.

The Respondent - Police or any other police in the State of Karnataka are directed to release the petitioners in the event of their arrest in Crime No.88/2024 registered by Nazarbad Police Station, Mysuru City for the offence punishable under Sections 406,
408, 420, 463, 464, 468, 470 & 471 of IPC, subject to the following conditions:
1. The Petitioners shall appear before the Investigating Officer within 15 days from the date of receipt of the copy of this order and shall NC: 2024:KHC:32739 execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
(one lakh only) each with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer.
2. Petitioners shall regularly appear before the Trial Court without fail unless exempted by the Trial Court for valid reasons.

3. Petitioners shall not tamper with the prosecution witnesses and they shall co-operate with the police for investigation and appear before them whenever called upon.
4. The petitioners shall not involve in similar offences in future.

Sd/-
